svg.title: Acceptance angle of an optical fiber
svg.desc: A ray enters the end of an optical fiber at the edge of its cone of acceptance, making angle αmax with the axis, bends toward the axis as it enters the core, and is guided along the core by total internal reflection at the boundary with the cladding. The two lines bounding the full acceptance angle meet at the fiber’s end. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Fiber acceptance follows from total internal reflection
Cladding n = 1.46
Core n = 1.50

α max (°)
Reflected %
Red: transmitted leakage; blue: core ray
Ray model in air. Entry refraction and the critical angle determine guidance. Outside the cone,
Fresnel reflection remains while some power leaks into cladding.
